featured_reviews.name: Ronit Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
After lunch at a hotel nearby, we were looking for dessert. After seeing the reviews online, we thought of trying some ice creams here.

We ordered the Butterscotch in a waffle cone and the Original Belgian Chocolate in a cup. The Butterscotch was true to its name and also had small crunchy cubes in between. But the texture and smoothness of the cream was perfect. The taste was delightful. The waffle cone was fresh and crunchy and perfectly complemented the cream.

While the Belgian chocolate was perfect, too. Slightly on the bitter side, as the original chocolate should be. The ice cream, though, was thicker than the Butterscotch one. But the taste was one of the best ones I have had. The not-too-sweet and strong taste of chocolate made it delightful in every bite.

All in all, the cafe is an amazing one. Clean, well maintained, and serving delicious snacks. A must-try one.

featured_reviews.name: Naziya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish I could rate this place beyond 5! Cream Lounge with its super cute and colourful decor serves great desserts and quick snack. It's interior is so attractive, seems like you are into a colourful wonderland full of desserts & candies.

The staff her is so humble, patient and understanding. That they will serve the next dish once you finish the first one. As they have you have you the fresh taste of each dish. Instead of bombarding you table with multiple items.

We had ordered:
London Berry Freak shake
Red velvet waffle
Over loaded mini pancakes
Churros with white chocolate

I still can't forget the flavour of hot Churros perfect tossed in cinnamon and served with hot white chocolate. Overloaded mini pancakes was another heavenly dish, full loaded with chocolate pearls, melted chocolate and a piece of brownie on each pancake. Red velvet being my favourite, served with white chocolate chips and syrup. London Berry being at the end. It's the most filling item. Thick shake, topped with whipped cream, cake slice, Candy pop and what not. Enjoyed it to the fullest!

featured_reviews.name: Divyendu Shekhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cream Lounge is located in Borivali and it is quite well known for it's delicious and beautiful desserts. I have been craving for desserts for quite sometime now unless I thought of ordering it from here instead.
It is pocket friendly and what I love about this place is that they don't compromise with the quality to make pocket friendly.
I ordered for some Cheesy Pizza Pockets, the taste was familiar yet only better. Then started the dessert spree. I ordered for Very Berry Sundae because I love Sundaes and Sundays. (Okay that was lame)
And how can I forget about the milkshake. Went for Toasted Nutella Milkshake and it was thick and delicious and I felt like licking the whole glass. I am drooling over it again.
Overall, if you crave for sweets or desserts and you haven't tried this place, you have no clue what you're missing out on buddy!❤️

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Sudarshan

I visited this place yesterday and i enjoyed my time here. Place is small they have 1 table indoor and others outdoor. Lights are really bright and it looks great.

Items i tried:
1. Chocolate overload pancake (5/5)- It was served fresh and taste was really awesome.
2. Tandoori chilli fries(5/5)- It was spicy and really drooly.. chilly sauce in it was very awesome.
3. Millionaires punch(5/5)- One of the best freak shakes i had. Kudos to the chef. I will visit this place again to have this.
4. Strawberry mint bubble (5/5)- this was also really awesome. I loved it

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Vansia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dessert Crazy?
This is the hotspot that will fulfill your cravings, with brand new desserts n dishes launching every now and then😍

LOCATION: This place is located at Yogi Nagar, on New Link Road, right at the corner of Aura Hotel.

AMBIENCE: This place is a super cute dessert cafe with limited indoor and outdoor seating space in vibrant neon interiors with aqua and lime coloured furniture. From displaying their colorful cones to their brand new dishes in the menu, it's all very chic. Must say, the music over here was very joyful.

MENU: They not only serve vegetarian quick bites but also some drooling thickshakes, freakshakes, pancakes, waffles, smoothies, sparklers and bubble teas. Their quick bites include alot of different styles of cheesy poppers, fancy fries, pizza pockets, etc.

STAFF: The staff here was very polite and welcoming. They were also very friendly and the service was super quick.

OFFERS: This place offers indoor as well as outdoor seating. And, they also provide home delivery to nearby areas.

FOOD: Everything here was very tasty. Unexpectedly delicious were the savoury dishes. Their range of freakshakes are superb and lip smacking and will literally soothe your inner cravings and their presentations are really worth the appreciation!!

WHAT WE HAD:
• Pizza Pasta French Fries
• Cheesy chilly pizza pockets
• Chocolate overload pancakes
• Millionaire's Punch Freakshake

ATTRIBUTES:
Ambience: 7/10
Taste: 10/10
Quality: 10/10
Quantity: 9/10
Service: 10/10
Value for money: 10/10

"Dear Food Maniacs, Thank you for reading".

Please follow us on Zomato and Instagram - Mumbai Food Maniac

featured_reviews.name: smit shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yes probably first time I had soo many varieties of shakes !!
Well i can say ,superb place.
Cream lounge has a variety of shakes available and even delicious tasty bites.
A popular place where u have desserts available at its best.
We ordered-

-Millionaires punch - it was amazing freak shake. It was full with so many types of chocolates and waffles .The shake was not only good as presentation but even the taste was super best. I can say the shake had a different creativity.
-Supershakes popcorn caramel - good in taste.
-Naughty hot fudge - The best sunday. I can say even a group of 3 can’t fully complete it as it was massive.
It was prepared meticulously.
It was lavish and excellent.

About the place- clean and neat place. Well arranged stuffs and it had screening of things they prepare.

Service- polite staff , way smart as they can guess what is our requirement and help us suggest things.
Fresh food and quality service being served.

Well recommend place !! U people can definitely go to this place located in Borivali west, just near to link road.
Definitely I m going to this place again !!

featured_reviews.name: Kirti Tyagi
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small junction located in Borivali West provides you with super tempting and delicious dessert.
We went here in an evening to try out their amazing collection. The staff was very sweet and gave us really good suggestions.
Food: We tried
1. London Berry Freakshake: This was freakingly awesome and absolutely amazing and was so huge. It had loads of toppings which include Strawberry ice cream cone, Pista Choco sticks, Pista cake and bubblegum icecream stick. Below this was Strawberry Milkshake. It was awesome.
2. Chocolate overload Pancakes: The pancakes were very soft and their was a brownie in top of that. It was lip smacking and they were covered in chocolate sauce with Chocolate toppings. The brownie and pancakes both were just melting in our mouth. I loved it.
3. Chipotle Cheese Fries: We had to order it as our rescue to a lot of sweetness. They were freshly made and were crunchy. The sauce on top of it was of correct amount which didn't make the fries soggy.
4. Mojito Lemonade: It was classic Mojito with a strong flavour of mint. I liked it.
Overall it was a dessertful experience!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had multiple flavours at Naturals including Sitaphal, Choco Bite, Roasted Almond and Coffee Walnut. The ingredients felt fresh and most flavours tasted natural — especially Sitaphal and Coffee Walnut, which were the best.

However, a couple of flavours didn’t stand out and felt average compared to the usual Naturals standard. Service was okay and the pricing is fair for the quality.

Good place for seasonal flavours, but could improve consistency across all options.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a dessert lover, this cute icecream outlet in Borivali West is a must-visit! We tried their Strawberry Cream and Monster Shake, and both were absolutely delightful.

🍓 The Strawberry Cream was fresh, creamy, and perfectly balanced in sweetness, making it a refreshing treat.
🥤 The Monster Shake was a visual and flavorful delight, loaded with indulgent toppings and rich flavors—a true showstopper!

The cozy ambiance and friendly staff added to the experience. Highly recommend stopping by for unique and satisfying desserts.

Can’t wait to try more flavors!😍

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a heaven for ice cream lovers.
I have visited here multiple times and tired different dessert and ice creams.
My top favourite is their ice cream rolls.
They make it live and we get wide range of flavours to choose from.
I tried kit kat, dark chocolate and chilli guava roll ice cream.
Their freak shakes are quite heavy and loaded and enough for 3-4 people
I tried better than your husband freak shake which had a chocolate base, loads of chocolate cream and toppings, it was very heavy for 2 people to finish.

Their regular ice creams are delicious and their seasonal menu is unique.
During summer must try their Talgoda sundae and mango sundae.

The mulberry fruit cream and mixed berry fruit cream is a must try.

They have a comfortable seating area, usually busy on weekend evenings.
The place is wheelchair accessible ♿✅
The prices are reasonable for the quality and quantity offered.

featured_reviews.name: Second Favorite
featured_reviews.review_text:
The only missing thing in MaKaBo's Mahavir Nagar khaugully is a Cafe where you can unwind and chill with your friends.

This cutesy cafe is all about chill vibes, great decor & sumptuous desserts & food.

AMBIANCE
Pastel shades, colorful wall murals, gorgeous wall mirrors and little frames - aptly describing my love for desserts 😋 Exactly a place you want to spend your afternoons, watching the rain pour outside 🌧️

FOOD
I believe in the quote, " Life's short!" So I started with a dessert 😋🤭

I went a little crazy looking at so many delicious options... You will know why, as you read through...

❤️ Brownie Nutella Waffle 🍫
Who doesn't like waffles, especially when it's loaded with chocolate?! Freshly baked waffle topped with milk and white chocolate chips, rice crisps and brownie crumbs.
#MustHave

❤️ Peri Peri Fries (Jain)
Long, crispy and unbelievable good. I never imagined Banana fries could taste good. Thancos surely has a secret to making some delicious Jain items. I tried this on the owner's recommendation &  it was totally worth it.
#WorthaTry

❤️ Fruity Exotica Waffle 🧇
After a delightful chocolaty experience, I couldn't stop at one. So I decided to indulge in the exotic fruity Waffles. So I wasn't too sure about how a fruity  waffle would be like. But this one was so good. Topped with fresh papaya, kiwi and pineapple & whipped cream, I got a sweet and tangy twist to my waffle and the best part it wasn't so sinful.
#yummy

❤️ Farm Fresh Pizza 🍕
I never miss a chance to have a pizza. I loved the trim crust pizza with toppings of bellpeppers, olives, jalapenos, babycorn and onions. It was a melt-in-the-mouth experience with a combination cheese of mozzarella, cheddar and processed cheese. It was an absolute delight.
#SFFWrecommends

🌰 NUTSHELL REVIEW
Head over to Thancos for a perfect evening with friends or family. Great snacks, droolworthy desserts and fantastic ambiance.
They are introducing some amazing rolls, burgers, bubble waffles and freakshakes. Can't wait to visit again 🥰

The ice-cream had strawberry essence to top with a small proportion of the fruit itself.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We were really keen on trying some good ice-cream and hence thought of ordering from the Amul Ice-Cream Parlor. Upon going through the menu we thought of ordering the RajBhog Flavored Ice-Cream.

Coming to the Quantity first, the quantity was amazing considering the cost and since Amul Ice-creams are made of pure milk. The taste was just super delicious. For those of you have actually tasted the Rajbhog sweet you will notice that the ice-cream tastes almost the same. And with the addition of all those dry fruits, it just gives the ice cream a slightly crunchier texture on the smoothness.

All in all the taste was super awesome and you can visibly notice the difference in the taste of ice-creams made of pure milk and ice-creams denoted as frozen desserts when you have this one. Simply said amazing taste and you will definitely be satisfied after having this. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Preeti Renikuntha
featured_reviews.review_text:
All time favorite stop!
Summers are no more boring when Amul is here!
Ranging from 50₹ a scoop to 100+₹
Amul has all varieties available always.
Seasonal fruit ice creams are a delight to one's prying eyes and is always tempting to be in the parlor.
Regular flavors like Pista, Strawberry & Vanilla are the cheapest ones but always the most tasty I feel.
Chocochips, Rajbhog, Seasonal fruit ice creams, thick shakes, Sundaes, Falooda, Lassi, Amul Kool, etc. Nowadays Amul stores have their fridge which also has Amul dairy products like Paneer, Lassi, Chaas, Cheese, etc.
Amul was, is and will always be my favorite!

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Old ice cream brand have changed the quality a lot
Some flavours are good some are below average.
Tried their roll cut anjeer ice cream was yumm it had crushed anjeer in it, sitaphal ice cream was mild to taste but had pieces of sitaphal in it.
The chocolate chip ice cream didn't taste good the quality of chips was low, felt like too much essence.
American nuts is a good option to try
The staff is a bit slow
There are a few chairs available outside to sit.
Takeaway and delivery available
Prices are reasonable.
They accept digital payments
They do not have accessible entrance ♿❌
